project_overview: 警务案件管理系统，用于案件注册、调查、起诉和搜索，提高警务工作效率和信息安全性

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: 系统管理员，负责用户管理和系统配置

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: 警务人员，负责案件调查和处理

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: 公民，可以注册投诉和查看案件状态

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: 帮助台人员，处理系统缺陷和增强请求

actors.name: RecordsStaff
actors.description: 记录室工作人员，负责案件记录管理

actors.name: ExternalAuditor
actors.description: 外部审计员，审查系统审计跟踪

constraints.description: 系统必须提供所有用户界面上所有可能操作和场景的详细上下文敏感帮助材料
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供用户界面用于记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: 系统必须在用户选择时发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）当对警报采取任何行动时
constraints.source_text: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

constraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word “unalterable” is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须自动跟踪事件并存储相关信息
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许将访问限制于特定用户或用户组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

constraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，配置必须保存在用户配置文件中
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
constraints.source_text: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

constraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

constraints.description: 系统必须支持多语言界面
constraints.source_text: The system should support multilingual interface

constraints.description: 系统设计应确保在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

constraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
constraints.source_text: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

constraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
constraints.source_text: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

constraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
constraints.source_text: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

constraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
constraints.source_text: Prevent cross-site scripting

constraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
constraints.source_text: Prevent SQL Injection

constraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记删除行
constraints.source_text: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

constraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁访问的数据
constraints.source_text: Use of cache for storing frequent data

constraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以最多10或20条为一批获取
constraints.source_text: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

constraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
constraints.source_text: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

constraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
constraints.source_text: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

constraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规行为
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user’s attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够按案件、用户和时间顺序提供案件操作报告
constraints.source_text: By case; By user; In chronological sequence. The System must at a minimum be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised:

constraints.description: 系统应能够按工作站和网络地址提供案件操作报告
constraints.source_text: The System should be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised by workstation and (where technically appropriate) by network address.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供角色基于功能的控制
constraints.source_text: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户属于多个组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: 系统应允许用户指定哪些其他用户或组可以访问案件
constraints.source_text: The System should allow a user to stipulate which other users or groups can access cases.

constraints.description: 系统必须对无权访问的案件请求提供可配置的响应
constraints.source_text: display title and metadata; display the existence of a case but not its title or other metadata; do not display any case information or indicate its existence in any way. If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

constraints.description: 系统必须将未经授权的案件访问尝试记录到审计跟踪中
constraints.source_text: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

constraints.description: 系统必须将所有案件访问和相关活动存储在审计跟踪中
constraints.source_text: Any access to cases, and all other activities involving the cases and related documents or data should also need to be stored in the audit trail to ensure legal admissibility and to assist in data recovery.

constraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
constraints.source_text: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

constraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集
constraints.source_text: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供易于使用和直观的终端用户和管理员功能
constraints.source_text: The System must provide End User and Administrator functions which are easy to use and intuitive throughout.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许数据输入的可持久默认值
constraints.source_text: user-definable values; values same as previous item; values derived from context, e.g. date, file reference, user identifier; The System must allow persistent defaults for data entry where desirable. These defaults should include:

constraints.description: 频繁执行的系统事务必须设计为可以用少量交互完成
constraints.source_text: Frequently-executed System transactions must be designed so that they can be completed with a small number of interactions (e.g. mouse clicks).

constraints.description: 图形用户界面必须允许用户自定义
constraints.source_text: menu contents; layout of screens; use of function keys; on-screen colours, fonts and font sizes; Where the System employs a graphical user interface, it must allow users to customise it. Customisation should include, but need not be limited to the following changes:

constraints.description: 用户界面应设计为用户直观的
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces should be designed to make them user-intuitive.

constraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

constraints.description: 系统应支持离线模式下的关键功能
constraints.source_text: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

constraints.description: 系统应设计为在低带宽连接的警察局也能有满意的性能
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

constraints.description: 系统应使用服务导向架构(SOA)和模块化设计实现
constraints.source_text: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

constraints.description: 系统应建立在开放标准上开发
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed on Open Standards

constraints.description: 系统应建立在通用用户访问和认证服务上，确保终端用户单点登录
constraints.source_text: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

constraints.description: 系统应设计为集中部署和维护
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

constraints.description: 系统应开发为部署在三层数据中心架构中
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

constraints.description: 系统应设计为n层架构，表示逻辑与业务逻辑分离，业务逻辑与数据访问逻辑分离
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

constraints.description: 系统应可扩展以通过PDA和移动数据终端提供接口访问
constraints.source_text: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA’s and mobile data terminals

constraints.description: 系统应采用标准化格式和通用元数据元素
constraints.source_text: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

constraints.description: 系统应设计为通过基于浏览器的系统访问，并对客户端设备要求最低
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

constraints.description: 系统必须支持多种类型的远程访问通信服务
constraints.source_text: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

constraints.description: 系统应具备支持公共访问部分数据和功能的能力
constraints.source_text: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

constraints.description: 系统应支持多级认证
constraints.source_text: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

constraints.description: 系统应支持SSL加密连接
constraints.source_text: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

constraints.description: 系统应支持安全虚拟专用网络连接
constraints.source_text: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

constraints.description: 系统应在多个浏览器上运行
constraints.source_text: The system should run on multiple browsers

constraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供检查
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不得有任何阻止在小或大型警察局使用的特性
constraints.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供在标准和峰值条件下常用功能的适当响应时间
constraints.source_text: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

constraints.description: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

constraints.description: 系统必须验证传入数据/用户请求
constraints.source_text: Validate the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: 系统必须编码传入数据/用户请求
constraints.source_text: Encode the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: 系统应使用参数化查询
constraints.source_text: Utilize parameterized queries

constraints.description: 系统应清理用户输入
constraints.source_text: Sanitize the user-inputs

constraints.description: 系统应在客户端和服务器端验证数据
constraints.source_text: Validate the data both at the client and server

constraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
constraints.source_text: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

constraints.description: 系统应考虑基于屏幕和估计使用模式的积极页面加载
constraints.source_text: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

constraints.description: 系统应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
constraints.source_text: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

constraints.description: 系统应在Web服务器上托管所有静态内容
constraints.source_text: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

constraints.description: 系统应以分页/分批方式在屏幕上显示记录
constraints.source_text: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

constraints.description: 系统应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

constraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据可供不熟悉系统的授权外部人员访问
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户跟踪提交的缺陷或增强请求
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.

constraints.description: 系统必须使帮助台用户能够查看按类别、状态和年龄分类的缺陷或增强请求报告
constraints.source_text: The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.

constraints.description: 支持解决方案必须可从应用程序内部和外部通过浏览器界面访问
constraints.source_text: The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

exceptions.trigger: 用户尝试访问没有权限的案件
exceptions.handling: 根据配置显示不同级别的响应（显示标题和元数据/仅显示存在/完全不显示）

exceptions.trigger: 尝试导出审计跟踪但功能未激活
exceptions.handling: 显示错误消息并提示激活审计功能

exceptions.trigger: 搜索操作超过规定时间
exceptions.handling: 终止搜索并显示超时错误

exceptions.trigger: 尝试访问不存在的案件
exceptions.handling: 显示错误消息并记录到审计跟踪

exceptions.trigger: 尝试执行需要登录的操作
